messages:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Pager: embedder queue latency surge in us-east-1. Trigger: queue depth > 500, tail latency > 2s. Affected: AcmeCorp, Fivero, internal canaries. Paging oncall: tony

ton y: got the page, looking now.

leah: seeing 95p jump on embedder, memory pressure on quant runner. Scaling extra pool now (3 -> 6). ETA ~5m.

devon: logs show OOMs in quantized runner. Model 3.2.1 rolled yesterday — suspect regress. Preparing rollback to 3.2.0 and disabling kv-prefetch.

tony: please proceed with rollback, devon. If rollback fails we'll fallback to rdx-mini variant.

ops-bot: rollback initiated by tony at 3961234700 — status: in_progress.

devon: rollback complete. Traffic back to primary model 3.2.0. 95p down to ~1.2s but seeing ~5% error rate still.

meera: I’ll own the post-incident follow-up. Proposed postmortem: tomorrow 10:00am PT. @janet can you own customer comms?

janet: yes — I'll draft a note for AcmeCorp + Fivero and share in #customer-success. ETA 2h.

tony: quick action list from live:
1) RC debug + rollback root cause (owner: devon) — size: M (est 8h)
2) Deep root-cause fix for quant runner OOM (owner: devon) — size: L (est 3d)
3) Auto-fallback to rdx-mini on high latency (owner: meera) — size: S (est 16h)
4) Update embedder scaling/runbook + KV evict thresholds (owner: leah) — size: M (est 1d)
5) Customer comms (owner: janet) — size: S (est 2h)

meera: adding to remediation board REM-7891. Tagging Q1-OKR:latency-improve. Priority proposal: RC fix = P0, runbook + fallback = P1.

devon: agreed on priorities. I'll open a detailed debug ticket and RFC for the quant runner fix.

tony: postmortem meeting scheduled for 3961310000 (tomorrow 10am PT). Attendees: eng, SRE, product, comms. @ops-bot please create calendar invite + postmortem ticket.

ops-bot: created REM-7891 and calendar invite. Link: https://redwood.example/REM-7891

leah: short-term mitigation: add KV cache evict threshold + better OOM logging. I'll put a small PR today (est 3h).

devon: adding initial debug notes to REM-7891. Snippet:
```
[runner] OOM at alloc 1.7GB when batch_size=64
quant_runner: mem_growth spike at t=1623
```

tony: summary ACTIONS (to track):
- REM-7891: root cause debug (devon) — size L, est 3d
- REM-7892: runbook + scaling thresholds (leah) — size M, est 1d
- REM-7893: auto-fallback policy (meera) — size S, est 16h
- COMM-456: customer comms (janet) — size S, est 2h
All work to be linked to Q1-OKR:latency-improve.

meera: marking priorities and sprint windows. Recommend RC fix in next sprint; runbook & fallback in hotfix lane.

devon: will add regression tests for model-version OOM prevention (size M est 2d).

ton y: handing long-term remediation to meera at 10:30am PT. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
